thread.title: Google Prices Phones, Home Hub Aggressively Amid Amazon, Apple Battle| Investor's Business Daily

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: Google Prices Phones, Home Hub Aggressively Amid Amazon, Apple Battle| Investor's Business Daily
text:
Google is becoming the low-priced vendor as it battles Apple ( AAPL ), Amazon.com ( AMZN ) and others in consumer electronics. Google stock edged down a fraction after the internet giant on Tuesday rolled out new Pixel phones and other hardware.
X Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google took the wraps off a pair of new Pixel smartphones , a tablet computer and a smart home hub equipped with a video screen.
Google, Apple, and Amazon aim to provide technology that is central to consumers' daily activities. Google aims to stay dominant in internet search, which generates advertising revenue, as voice-assisted technology and artificial intelligence software spread into more consumer devices.
Google's new smart speaker, priced at $149, competes with Amazon's video-screen equipped Echo Show 2. Amazon's device costs about $230, more than 50% more than the new Google Home Hub.
The new Pixel 3 and larger-screen Pixel 3XL smartphones, start at $799 and $899. Google may be aiming to provide more features in a price range in between Apple's newest devices.
Apple's new iPhone XR, with an LCD screen, starts at $749 for the 64-gigabyte version. The iPhone XS starts at $999, with the XS Max at $1,099.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Google Hardware Crimps Margins Google's push into consumer hardware has increased product development and marketing costs, eroding profit margins. But it's racing other technology giants to make electronic devices that generate advertising, or in the case of Apple, service revenue.
Facebook ( FB ) on Monday unveiled a new, voice-activated smart-home device. The Facebook device utilizes Amazon Alexa voice-assisted technology.
Google trails Amazon in the smart-home speaker market. Google's smartphone sales are a drop in the bucket compared to Apple iPhone sales.
Google Stock Weakens Beyond phones and speakers, Google also introduced a convertible tablet, called the Pixel Slate. The device, which runs on the Chrome OS software, starts at $599. It competes with Microsoft 's ( MSFT ) convertible tablets.
Google stock slipped 0.9% to close at 1,145.17 on the stock market today . Google stock is up 17% from a year ago. That lags Amazon's 89% gain and Apple's 46% pop over the same period.
Shares in Google have weakened from an all-time high of 1,291.44 set on July 27.
Google is trading below its 50-day-moving-average. Google faces tougher regulation amid a backlash involving consumer data privacy.
